manifest.description: Global Cylindrical Equirectangular Topographic Map of Titan (-1800 m to +600 m), Corlies et al. (2017) / NASA / JPL-Caltech
Global Geologic Map of Titan at 1:20,000,000 scale in Mollweide projection, Lopes et al. (2019/2020) / ESA / NASA / JPL-Caltech / ASI
Topographic map with North Pole and South Pole polar stereographic insets and global strip (-1600 m to +700 m), Corlies et al. (2017)
Full-resolution tri-panel geomorphology map with polar projections and unit legend, Lopes et al. (Nature Astronomy, 2019)
Complete quantitative dataset of Titan atmospheric pressure, scale height, gas composition, methane hydrologic cycle, and radiative balance
